target.title: docs: refresh landing hero to current brand and complete quick-start grid
target.body:
Closes #102878

## What Problem This Solves

The docs landing page (https://docs.openclaw.ai/) and README still led with the retired cartoon crawfish wordmark while everything around them (openclaw.ai, the docs shell coral/ink theme, og-cards) already uses the round mascot brand. The quick-start grid on the landing page also renders as a 2x2 with only three cards, leaving an empty fourth slot.

## Why This Change Was Made

Brings the two most visible doc surfaces onto the current brand and completes the onboarding funnel. New hero banners were generated with the Codex CLI (image_generation) from the canonical mascot references (openclaw.ai og-image/favicon) as transparent dark/light variants; the fourth card ("Connect a Channel") fills the funnel gap between onboarding and the Control UI. The Mintlify backup palette in `docs.json` moves from the old orange (#FF5A36) to the site coral tokens (#D84A31 / #F5654A / #E05540). The retired logo assets (`openclaw-logo-text*.png/svg`) are deleted; README now uses the new hero PNGs.

Companion PR (docs shell): openclaw/docs#96 renders card icons from lucide so the new card's `message-circle` icon (and ~150 other icon names across docs) resolve instead of falling back to a generic tile.

## User Impact

Docs visitors and GitHub readers see the current OpenClaw brand instead of the retired logo, and the landing page quick-start grid is a complete 2x2: Get Started, Run Onboarding, Connect a Channel, Open the Control UI.

## Evidence

Rendered with the Cloudflare docs shell (`openclaw/docs` preview build; before = production docs.openclaw.ai).

| Before (dark) | After (dark) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/docs-landing-redesign/before-dark.png) | ![after dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/docs-landing-redesign/after-dark.png) |

| Before (light) | After (light) |
| --- | --- |
| ![before light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/docs-landing-redesign/before-light.png) | ![after light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/docs-landing-redesign/after-light.png) |

Note: the "after" shots come from the local preview build (30-page nav subset), which is why fewer nav tabs/sidebar entries are visible — that is a preview artifact, not part of this change.

Validation: `docs.json` parses, `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md` (704 files pass), `node scripts/docs-link-audit.mjs` (5778 links, 0 broken), `node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs` clean, `git diff --check` clean. Docs-only change; no runtime surface.
